title: Command injection through unvalidated input passed to os.system
impact: Whatever the caller types is executed by the shell, so any input reaching run_report becomes arbitrary command execution with the process's privileges.
description: run_report reads a string from input() and hands it straight to os.system, which runs it through a shell. Nothing validates, escapes, or constrains the value between the two, so shell metacharacters in the input are interpreted rather than treated as data.
recommendation: Do not pass user input through a shell. Use subprocess.run with an argument list and shell=False, and constrain the command to a known-good set rather than accepting an arbitrary string.
